title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → StudentProgram
architecture_notes: Workday Student tracks a student's enrollment in a Program of Study as a Program Enrollment (the student's active/historical academic program record). This is the join between Student and Program, carrying declaration dates, status, GPA within program, and expected completion. Equivalent to PS_ACAD_PROG (student-level rows) + PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM.

source_objects.description: Student's enrollment in a program: student, program, status, start, expected completion, academic standing. Equivalent to PS_ACAD_PROG.
Declared majors/minors and dates. Equivalent to PS_ACAD_PLAN (student rows).
Good standing, probation, dismissal. Equivalent to PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM.ACAD_STNDNG_STAT.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map or composite of student + program + start.

attribute_mappings.source: Student Field of Study Declaration where Type='Major'
attribute_mappings.transformation: Array of declared majors with declaration dates.

attribute_mappings.source: Student Field of Study Declaration where Type='Minor'

attribute_mappings.transformation: Null if not completed. Cast to ISO 8601.
The catalog/requirement year governing this student's degree requirements.

notes: FERPA-protected. The catalog_year is critical for degree audit — it locks the requirements the student must satisfy.
